notes.title: Save Features Patch Out Now!
notes.content:
[b]Defenders of the Unholy Realm![/b]

After thorough testing, we are confident and excited to push out our first Patch to you all!


[b]New Features & Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The game settings now save. 
[*] Both game modes have a save system now. They got a new screen (we love Kaii's goat art) and you can choose between "Continue Run" and "New Run". The game automatically saves each wave at the start of your turn. 
[*] The text for healing units has been updated to be less confusing.
[*] We fixed a minor sound bug.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045035/37b64dd4a04b0d53126c45f28032772b67bb9aad.png[/img]

We know that there are still soft freezes that impact your experience. Our priority for the past weeks was to get a functioning save system into our game. At the same time, we hope that the save system, and thus the possibility to load the game after a soft freeze, helps your experience overall.

Thank you for your continued support,

Kaii, Kevin, Arnd

notes.title: The Metal Queen Dungeon Soundtrack is Out Now!
notes.content:
[b]Dungeoneers![/b]

Metal Queen Dungeon just hit its next milestone! We just released our first soundtrack to Steam for you all to listen to wherever and whenever you want to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045035/640a12b349e8fcd7db5d0480062685e1e24ee687.png[/img]

The goal was to create a soundtrack that immerses you all into the progressing intensity of each wave of relentless enemy attacks in Metal Queen Dungeon, and we could not be any happier with the result.

Arnd, who composed the different tracks, spent many months working and refining each track with his utmost love for detail and his passion for film music and heavy metal!

Growing up listening to different genres of guitar-emphasized music, touring as a musician for half his life, this is not only a dream come true for our entire team but especially for him, as he was never this close to releasing his solo work before.

With the game growing, we are also hoping to bring more tracks to the soundtrack for you all to enjoy as a free update.

Thank you again from the bottom of our hearts for supporting our art,

Kaii, Kevin, Arnd

notes.title: We are working on our first Patch!
notes.content:
[b]Defenders of the Unholy Realm,[/b]

We wanted to take a moment to extend our deepest gratitude to you all! Thank you for buying the game, wishlisting, writing a review, and discussing and helping each other in the community section.

Your support has helped us climb up to the top five of New & Trending within the Roguelike Deckbuilder tag! We could not be any happier right now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045035/c4ffad3792335e9b607408e5236bf0771c4a1652.png[/img]

To address some of the important topics in the community:

[list]
[*] Some of you have asked for specific display resolutions for the game.
Sadly, this is something we will not be able to offer as the base resolution of the game simply does not scale to these resolutions while staying pixel accurate.

[*] We are currently working on a system to save your game settings and are confident we will roll out this feature with a patch next week.

[*] Saving in the game modes is also being worked on, and we are exploring options on how to implement this much-requested feature.

[*] We will also reword ability texts of cards with healing abilities as they have caused some confusion.

[*] The Metal Queen Dungeon Soundtrack is going to hit the store next week! Go ahead and wishlist the soundtrack if you have not done so yet!
[/list]

There is a lot to do and we are looking forward to making the experience of Metal Queen Dungeon even better!

Keep bonking,

Your KRAKL Games Team

notes.title: We are live! HELP!
notes.content:
[b]Did we really just press ‘release’?[/b]

After 7 months of development, we went live today with a game that was intended to be a really small project, but then blew up into something none of us thought was possible!

[b]Metal Queen Dungeon[/b] is a result of our combined passions: beautiful pixel art, strategic deck-building, turn and grid-based combat, and super chunky metal music!

[b]Everything you need to know:[/b]

[list]
[*] Survive relentless waves of heroes, each wave more challenging than the last.
[*] Build an evil army by playing cards onto a grid-based battlefield.
[*] Play powerful minion, structure, and spell cards from five different factions.
[*] Take control over the battle with manipulation, destruction, and movement spells.
[*] Customize your deck by adding game-changing cards of different rarities or burning those that don’t fit your strategy.
[*] Utilize the stacking mechanic to strategically accumulate minions on a single tile.
[*] Conquer the Classic Mode against a legendary hero or test your limits in Endless Mode.
[*] Enjoy an original soundtrack ranging from doomy orchestral music to absolute face-melting metal riffage!
[/list]

This is our first game, and we hope to have brought you a stable and extremely fun experience, where you can try out combinations with 58 different cards against 19 different enemy units!

In the next days and weeks, we will squash bugs that surface and make the game a little bit more sparkly (as sparkly as it can get in a dungeon full of Gnolls and Orcs). Please be patient, as we are only a tiny team of three with no publisher.

We are more than thrilled to hear about your experiences, your chosen strategies, and the one card that already has a special place in your heart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045035/ace654b4e2b9cdcaee1f791d587767bf5b35ab42.png[/img]
Thank you for all the support,
Kaii, Kevin, Arnd
